name: Website Screenshot & PDF API
tagline: Full-page screenshots (PNG/JPEG/WebP) and PDFs of any URL, with cookie banners removed.
description: Give it one URL or thousands; get full-page or viewport screenshots (PNG, JPEG, WebP) and PDFs, each with a direct fileUrl, width/height, title and status. Runs real Chrome: removes cookie banners, loads lazy images, fixes sticky headers, hides popups, renders emoji and CJK text. Element capture, wait-for-selector, dark mode, custom CSS, headers and cookies. Pay per file via Apify: $0.01 per run + $0.008 per screenshot (Free plan, down to $0.005) and $0.012 per PDF; failures are never charged.
whenToChoose: You need a picture or PDF of a public web page in one call: PNG, JPEG, WebP and PDF from the same run, desktop, laptop, tablet or mobile (iPhone 3x) presets or a custom viewport.
You need clean captures: cookie banners clicked away on 30+ consent platforms plus 'Accept' text in 30+ languages, lazy images loaded, sticky headers shown once, chat widgets and popups hidden.
You need PDF control: paper size, margins, landscape, print or screen CSS, or one single long page.
You need to pay only for delivered files: failed, blocked (bot check), HTTP-error, blank and over-budget URLs are free and come back with errorType and a retry hint.
You need a hard cost cap: maxTotalChargeUsd stops cleanly and marks the rest SPENDING_LIMIT (cloud-tested 18 Oct 2026).
Pre-release cloud QA (18 Oct 2026): 28/28 reachable sites on desktop and 27/27 on mobile, 11/11 option scenarios; bot-protected sites failed as BLOCKED and were not charged.
chooseAnotherToolWhen: You need a sub-second synchronous HTTP endpoint (this runs as batch jobs, typically 5-30 s per page) or reliable access to sites behind enterprise bot protection (WSJ, G2, Zillow, Indeed still blocked residential IPs in our tests).
auth: OAuth (sign in with Apify) or header Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>
